text: Inert Centurion Core is located in Bastion. The core also drops from Darksworn Forgehands at the Eternal Forge.
Infernal Cascade is a conduit for fire mages. It drops from Margrave Stradama in Plaguefall, the Sun King's Salvation in Castle Nathria, and Dausegne in the Sepulcher of the First Ones..
Inevitable Demise is an Azerite trait available to Affliction warlocks.
Infernal Brand is a conduit for destruction warlocks. It drops from Amarth in the Necrotic Wake and Sylvanas Windrunner in the Sanctum of Domination.

Infectious Zombies are ghouls that spawn occasionally during Death Rising. As hostile mobs, they will attack NPCs, creatures, and players alike. Attacks tend to infect players, which will turn them into zombies as well.
Infinite Fury is an Azerite trait available to Fury warriors.
__NOTOC__ Infectious Scavengers are ghouls located at Icecrown Glacier in Icecrown.
The Infested Necroray is looted from the Oozing Necroray Egg.

The Infested Vestige is located at in a cave in the Seeker's Quorum in Korthia. One of the Treasures of Korthia, it is guarded by a swarm of Agitated Deathroaches. Loot it for an Abandoned Broker Satchel, which contains 5x Tattered Scroll (Shadowlands) and a Korthite Crystal.

Injured Goblin Miners are goblin quest givers found inside the spider-infested Crystalweb Cavern in the Storm Peaks. They have been bitten by an Icetip Crawler and asks adventurers to retrieve its venom sac in order to allow Ricket to make an antidote. They thereafter ask adventurers to escort them to the mouth of the cavern to allow them to run back to K3.

.]] Stacks of Infused Saronite Bars can be found littering the ground in the Pit of Saron of the Frozen Halls in Icecrown Citadel. The Infused variety have a green miasma steaming off of them. Other stacks of Saronite Bars do not have this glow. The use of five bars are required for the quest Reforging The Sword, along with a drop from Forgemaster Garfrost, The Forgemaster's Hammer, to reforge the Remnants of Quel'Delar into the Reforged Quel'Delar.

Injured Gnomes are gnomes found in the Old Dormitory of Gnomeregan. The player starts out as one such gnome, suffering from severe radiation and in danger of turning into a leper gnome.

An enterprising merchant making regular guns along the dangerous trade routes between Nighthaven and Theramore commissioned the creation of the inflatable soldier. Made of shappe's bladders with an outer covering of mercenary garb, inflatable soldiers make overnight camps appear better guarded than they truly are. As they gain popularity among merchants to poor or too cheap to hire full escorts, inflatable soldiers are of increasing realism (with facial features, chain shirts, and tin helms) are becoming available, as are models appearing to be members of varying humanoid races. Injured Razor Hill Grunts can be found along the beach of eastern Durotar. Although they will not have an exclamation mark over their heads, they will give a quest to rescue four of their number. After being rescued, each grunt will follow the player for a short time while they recover, but will not engage in combat. They will then leave, thanking the player. Note that, while the grunts are always happy to be rescued, they do not offer their quest until you have completed the quest From Bad to Worse.

Influence Tentacles are spawned during the Yogg-Saron encounter at the end of the Ulduar instance. After passing through the portals, players enter one of three possible illusions. Each of them is a circular room with a door to the brain room right at the spot where players enter. The door is blocked, in order to open it, the Influence Tentacles in the first room need all to be killed. Influence Tentacles are disguised as neutral mobs with the "Nondescript" buff and always stand along the outer wall around the room. All attackable mobs in the room are tentacles. Depending on the vision, the tentacles are disguised as Deathsworn Zealots; Suits of Armor; or Azure, Emerald, Obsidian, and Ruby C

__NOTOC__ Inkbinders Rise is a small vrykul village located in the eastern Field of Fallen Kings in Stormheim. Its collection of houses sit in the shadow of Haustvald, and is home to loyalists of the Bonespeakers. As its name suggests, the rise also appears to be the center of the Bonespeakers' inkbinding traditions, which they employ in rituals and combat.

Injured Riding Rams are level 100 rams spread around Dun Morogh during the Legion Invasions. They can be healed to improve the score of defense against the Legion. They can only be healed by Alliance adventurers.

Infinitesimal is an achievement earned for defeating the Grand Magistrix Elisande encounter in the Nighthold instance on Normal difficulty or higher, after carrying out a series of steps involving the Infinite Whelpling pet. Specifically, the pet must be active and be moved through two overlapping bubbles left behind by each type of boss's elemental adds, and kept there for several seconds. After doing this, the whelpling will be transformed into a hostile drake that must be slain. Doing that, and then defeating Elisande, will award the achievement.

The Inkgill jinyu are based in Inkgill Mere in Kun-Lai Summit. Elder Shai Hu drank the sha-corrupted waters of the mere, and forced the others to do the same. When Waterspeaker Gorai protested, Orachi of the town guard confiscated his ritual staff and banished him. Not all of the villagers were corrupted. Many heeded Gorai's warnings and did not drink of the sha-tainted waters. They went into hiding, terrified, and intimidated by the guards. Merchant Shi arrived at the mere to trade, but his caravan was instead attacked by the jinyu.
